Tooltip_item_MNWheelbarrow:
Hauls very heavy loads: generators, logs, propane tanks.
Light items gain nothing from it, and only a little fits.
Occupies both hands, and you cannot run while pushing it.
Set it on the ground to load it.
Tooltip_craft_MNWBWheelbarrow:
Welds a wheelbarrow from sheet metal, pipe and a car tyre.
Needs a blowtorch, welding rods and a mask, so it is not an early-game build.
